Etsy sellers, before you panic about the new AI image rules… READ THIS. 👇 Etsy is NOT banning AI-generated images or mockups across the board. But there are some important distinctions sellers need to understand. Here's what you need to know: ✨ AI-generated digital products are still permitted when they meet Etsy's Creativity Standards, including disclosure requirements. ✨ Print-on-demand sellers can still use qualifying mockups, but your images need to accurately represent the product your customer will receive. ✨ Handmade and physical product sellers have stricter photo requirements. Not every AI-generated lifestyle image is acceptable as a replacement for real product photography. #etsysellersoftiktok #etsysmallbusiness #printondemand #fyppp #etsymockups
